text_markup: The symbol [recurring] (plaintext: {curly:recurring}) stands for recurring credit. It always appears with a quantity, such as 1[recurring], which means "one recurring credit," or 3[recurring], which means "three recurring credits." See {ref:rule_sec_recurring} for rules about recurring credits.
text_plain: The symbol {recurring} (plaintext: {recurring}) stands for recurring credit. It always appears with a quantity, such as 1{recurring}, which means "one recurring credit," or 3{recurring}, which means "three recurring credits." See section 1.10.5 for rules about recurring credits.
